node.html: This website's source code. Developed using Gatsby and React.JS

InstaQuiz is an AI-powered quiz generator that instantly transforms PDF learning materials into interactive quizzes. Built for students and educators, it leverages natural language processing (NLP) to enhance assessment efficiency and engagement.

Memory Lane Journal is a personal journaling Android app designed to help users capture and preserve memories through text notes, images, and daily entries. Built with secure Firebase authentication and real-time database integration, users can write, organize, and browse journal entries alongside a visual gallery.

A modern and efficient task management application built using PHP Laravel and Vue.js, designed to help users organize their daily activities with ease. The system allows users to create, update, delete, and track tasks in real time through a responsive and user-friendly interface.

A modern and dynamic blogging platform built with Laravel, Vue.js, and Axios, designed for seamless content creation and user interaction. It features a responsive interface, efficient data handling, and a smooth user experience — perfect for publishing and managing articles with ease.

A powerful inventory management system developed using Laravel, Vue.js, and Axios. This application helps track products, manage stock levels, and organize data efficiently through a clean and user-friendly dashboard — ideal for small to medium businesses.
A full-stack job board web application built with Laravel, Vue.js, and MySQL. The system supports three user roles — admin, company, and applicant — each with their own set of permissions and views.
A practical collection of MySQL exercises focused on SQL queries, database schema design, and optimization techniques — built to strengthen core database skills through hands-on examples.
